cleanParagraphs: The magic gourd suddenly pulled everyone into the Reverse Valley. Behind them, the narrow exit became smaller as the Snake Spirit chanted outside. Big Brother rushed toward it, but a violent force threw him back. Grandpa warned the brothers to slow down, while Ms. Lin asked Summer to watch the valley before anyone tried again.

Summer noticed a broken stone bridge blocking the path and led Big Brother there. He lifted the heavy stones while Third Brother blocked falling rocks with his strong body. Together, they restored the crossing for their companions. A bright red mark appeared above the safe path, and everyone finally understood the valley's strange rule: a power worked only after it helped someone else.

Beyond the bridge, the path narrowed into a hot stone passage between dark rocks. Fierce wind pushed at anyone who moved ahead alone. Second Brother studied the walls and called, “The wind is blowing through three holes, and I am finding a safe route along the left side.” He then marked the calmer path with small stones for everyone.

Flames still danced across the hot ground. Fifth Brother said, “I am pouring water over the fire, and the rocks are becoming cooler now.” Ms. Lin asked Summer to divide the team into two groups. Summer guided the brothers forward after Second Brother, and Fifth Brother extinguished every flame. When all companions crossed the narrow gap, two shining marks appeared and opened the road to the valley's center.

At the valley's center, a tightening thorn net surrounded a high stone platform where Grandpa waited. Sixth Brother turned invisible and slipped inside instead of attacking the thorns. He reached Grandpa and passed him a rope. Grandpa whispered, “The thorn net is growing tighter whenever someone pushes it, so follow the open spaces beside my platform.”

Sixth Brother held the rope while Grandpa climbed down. From inside, he called, “The thorns are moving away from the right edge now.” Fourth Brother checked everyone's position, then burned a safe opening through that edge. The team rescued Grandpa from the platform and gathered around him. He recognized carved lines on the stone and explained that the exit required all seven marks in the correct order.

The Snake Spirit began chanting backward outside the valley, and the last two marks flew toward the magic gourd. Each brother who tried to grab them fell backward. Seventh Brother watched the gourd and said, “The spell is pulling the marks toward its mouth, but I am planning a different use for it. We must guide them instead of swallowing them.”

Third Brother stood in front of the team and resisted the returning force. Big Brother held the gourd's opening steady while Seventh Brother aimed it at an empty crack. “The marks are passing through the gourd now,” he called. He sent them safely into his companions' hands instead of trapping anyone. The sixth and seventh marks shone together, and the team finally completed the seven-color set.

Although all seven marks were ready, the exit kept changing their places. Grandpa pointed to the carved pattern, and Summer raised the marks where everyone could see them. Ms. Lin told the brothers to remember whom each power had helped first. Summer said, “The door follows our helpful steps, and a wrong order closes it again. Follow the story we made together.”

One by one, the brothers will place their marks into the glowing pattern in that order. Summer checked every color, while Ms. Lin kept the team calm. Seventh Brother said, “The last mark belongs here, and then the light will carry us home.” When he will fit it into place, a rainbow gateway opened. Everyone will lead Grandpa back to the courtyard, and the Snake Spirit's spell faded away.

mainIdea.text: After the magic gourd pulled Summer, Ms. Lin, Grandpa, and the seven brothers into the Reverse Valley, the Snake Spirit's spell made every selfish attack dangerous. The group discovered that each special power could create a colored mark only after it helped a companion. Big Brother and Third Brother repaired a bridge, Second Brother and Fifth Brother guided everyone through a hot passage, and Sixth Brother and Fourth Brother rescued Grandpa from a thorny platform. Seventh Brother then changed the magic gourd from a tool that swallowed people into one that carried the final marks safely. Following Grandpa's clue, Summer and Ms. Lin helped the brothers remember the order of their helpful actions. The seven correctly placed marks opened the exit, returned everyone home, and ended the spell.
